issue_context.title: Godot crashes, when you change root node to something unpredictable
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

4.2.1 Steam version

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

I changed Sprite3D to subviewport, while it was root node and godot just closed instantly

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create scene with Sprite3D as a root node
2. Give it a texture and enable billboard
3. Change Sprite3D to sub-viewport

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

It happened once, I tried to make it again, but everything is fine
comments: I have checked and it is most likely #78372 which is the culprit and it escalated into a crash now.
